This repetition confirms that the data collection is not a one-time event but an ongoing, longitudinal study. A critical aspect of the survey’s design, highlighted in every single note, is the method of data extension. Rather than creating entirely new, disconnected records for each visit, the team employs a practice where later visits extend existing records with new readings. This approach is fundamentally important for glaciology, as it allows for the direct comparison of metrics over time within the same spatial context.
